title: Voice control in the web workspace via on-device Moonshine
description:
As a human running a software factory from hey.chattic.us, I want to talk to my bots hands-free for as long as I like, so that I can orchestrate work by voice without paying for a live multimodal stream.

Principle: functional, cheap, intelligent voice control -- not a human impersonation. Listening, VAD, transcription, and common commands run on-device in the browser (Moonshine). Cloud/AI activity happens only when the user actually says something that needs a bot, and then it is an ordinary one-turn request.

Not included: a persistent audio stream to a cloud model, WebSockets, realtime multimodal APIs, human-like voice persona.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Status 2026-10-04: research (9a4a1d) merged as docs/VOICE.md in PR #383. Spike a2000f (PR #384, open) shows always-on Tiny Streaming is feasible on desktop Chromium and WebKit: ~4% CPU idle / 12% in speech with a 2-thread pool, ~0.6 s line latency, ~1.0 GB flat over 12 min. Gates before building continuous listening: 7605d6 live-mic 60-min/background/battery; eddc14 iOS memory; 604bb6 COOP/COEP require-corp vs sign-in and Vultus (blocks shipping any voice page); 070c91 upstream thread-pool setting (needed for a supported low-CPU config). Design follow-ups filed: 0fcfa8 phonetic name matching, 46b47f word-only confirmation codes, 66f189 turn cancel (gates 'stop'), d39faf postMessage Idempotency-Key, 057250 Tactus upstream asks. Voice HITL also waits on the manual HITL card in web/. Push-to-talk dictation (build step 2) is the first build story once 604bb6 clears.

## Milestone: voice is live on development (2026-10-04)

Development is now **https://develop.chattic.us** (chatticus-development account); `dev.chattic.us` is the stale legacy deployment.

**Live on develop / development**
- #383 `docs/VOICE.md` research; #384 Moonshine WASM spike and results.
- #385 voice in the workspace: on-device Moonshine STT, teammate names as the wake word, local command grammar. COOP/COEP on the **development distribution only**. Story chatticus-a8066a closed.
- #389 spoken replies via browser `speechSynthesis`, hands-free stop, self-hearing protection. Story chatticus-12096f closed.
- Related turn work: #387 gpt-5-nano and a permanent model-provider error fails the turn at once with a readable reason (#386 folded in); #388 failed reply stays visible with reason and Retry, `GET /channels/{id}/turns/latest`, slow-turn notice.
